prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Save Your New Companion", "Sign in to connect your pet to your account and keep it safe across devices."]
1: ["Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Home", "Your companion is getting ready. Learn how to interact with it on your screen while you wait.", "Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime to open actions, settings, or hide it."]
2: ["Choose Your Companion Style", "Select an instant preset pet or generate a custom pet from your photos.", "Instant Pet (Ready now) vs Custom Pet (Generative)"]
3: ["Desktop Pet Quick Controls", "Master how to summon, move, and chat with your companion anywhere on your desktop.", "Drag to move | Right-click for options | Double-click to talk", "Got It!"]
4: ["Signing in links your pet to your email address so your progress is never lost.", "Cloud Save Active"]
5: ["How Would You Like to Create Your Pet?", "Quick Pick (1 min) or Custom Creation (3 mins)"]
6: ["Hatching Your Desktop Pet...", "We are generating your desktop companion graphics. You can minimize this window.", "Rendering desktop animations..."]
7: ["Your Companion is Ready to Walk Your Desktop!", "Click below to bring your companion straight onto your screen.", "Spawn Pet on Desktop"]
8: ["Upload Photo for Custom Desktop Pet", "Clear, well-lit front photos give the best desktop companion results!", "Drag & drop pet photo here"]
9: ["Welcome to Desktop Pets", "Meet your virtual companion living right on your screen.", "Jump Straight to Adopt"]

verdicts.problem: Suggests skipping onboarding or required setup steps.
